text: Take a slow breath in, and let it go.
Feel the weight of your body grounding into the space beneath you.
Just a moment to reconnect with yourself.
With your next inhale, allow the center of your chest to soften, and with the exhale,
feel a quiet strength gather in your body.
Resistance isn't something you force, it's something that rises naturally when you're
steady, calm, and present.
Let your shoulders release.
Let your jaw loosen.
Let your breath fall into an easier rhythm.
You are here.
You are aware.
And that's enough.
Feel the ground supporting you.
Feel the breath moving through you.
Feel the subtle clarity gathering in your mind, just a gentle inner yes, a quiet knowing
of your own capability.
With each breath, allow yourself to take up a little more internal space, a little more
presence, a little more trust in your own steadiness.
You can move through the world with grounded strength, you can act from clarity.
Take one more slow inhale, and as you let it go, feel a soft sense of confidence expand
through your chest.
You're ready for what's next, and you can return to this steadiness anytime.
